samir: Quick follow-up from the GPU surge postmortems. Consolidated actions into a single board so we don't duplicate work. Need owners and ETAs.

elaine: link?

samir: https://rwd.internal/infra/boards/gpu-action-2026 - I merged dup tickets into #7810.

elaine: I'll own quota liaison. Will request A100 and compatible quantized SKUs in two regions tomorrow AM. ETA: submit by Mon, cloud reply ~48-72h. Mark #7810 blocked until approval.

raj: I'll own autoscaler tuning. Short plan: move from fixed headroom to latency-percentile-driven headroom, add EWMA smoothing of demand, and small standby_pool. Draft config sketched in PR.

elaine: monitoring/runbook owner?

samir: marta will own runbook & alerts, but tagging you for quota. ops-bot: create subtasks and recurring check-ins.

ops-bot: Created tasks: #7810 (quota request) -> elaine, #7811 (autoscaler tuning) -> raj, #7812 (runbook & alerts) -> marta. Recurring 15-min checks Tue/Thu for 3 weeks added.

raj: PR draft by Wed with one-line smoke tests.

marta: runbook draft by Thu; add alert if effective_headroom_pct < 12% for 10m.

samir: good. we'll reconvene after quota reply and first canary. Closing thread.
